findings.finding: Direct worker invocation is not bound to authorization, durable state or a one-use parent capability.
findings.action: Bind worker ID and exact paths to nonce/lease in a durable one-use capability before any worker output or production import.

findings.finding: Handled execution-state creation faults delete staging and can erase authorization-consumption evidence.
findings.action: Fsync the parent after staging creation and preserve all nonce-bound staging for terminal reconciliation.

findings.finding: Failure-bundle publication has no recovery for process crashes before atomic rename.
findings.action: Add nonce-and-lease-bound recoverable failure staging and process-level fault tests.

findings.finding: Raw worker-issued receipts are deleted and the portable receipt lacks an exact final audit.
findings.action: Retain raw receipts, bind their file SHA, freeze portable schema and audit copied evidence after rename.
